title: Inference-Time Graph Engineering for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2609.05774v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent multi-agent LLM systems increasingly rely on graph-structured communication to coordinate specialized agents. We revisit multi-agent orchestration from a graph-engineering perspective: rather than optimizing a static topology, we synthesize a task-conditioned temporal workflow graph that jointly specifies agent connectivity and edge-level communication semantics. We introduce ReActNet, a training-free framework that compiles a query and a set of role-specialized agents into a sequence of directed communication graphs. Each graph snapshot corresponds to one reasoning stage, and each edge carries a natural-language instruction specifying the message that a source agent should provide to a target agent. translated_title: 面向多智能体大语言模型工作流的推理时图工程
translated_abstract: 近年来，多智能体大语言模型系统日益依赖图结构化的通信来协调专业化智能体。我们从图工程的视角重新审视多智能体编排：不再优化静态拓扑结构，而是合成一种任务条件化的时序工作流图，该图同时规定了智能体之间的连接关系和边级别的通信语义。我们提出了ReActNet，这是一个无需训练的框架，能够将查询和一组角色专业化智能体编译为一系列有向通信图。每个图快照对应一个推理阶段，每条边都携带自然语言指令，用于指明源智能体应向目标智能体传递的消息内容。编译后的时序图随后通过结构化消息传递机制执行：智能体通过整合自身先前的状态与控制器分配的邻居所发送的消息来更新推理状态，最终由聚合器综合出最终结果（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出无需训练的ReActNet框架，通过在推理时将查询编译为任务条件化的时序通信图——每个图快照对应一个推理阶段、每条边携带自然语言消息指令——从而动态编排多智能体大语言模型工作流。
en_tdlr: Proposes ReActNet, a training-free framework that dynamically orchestrates multi-agent LLM workflows at inference time by compiling queries into task-conditioned temporal communication graphs, where each snapshot represents a reasoning stage and each edge carries natural-language message instructions.
